svg.text: Componentized Sweater Vest — production body fit
The secondary-fabric panel, V-neck inset, and buttons are front-only. East/west carry no vest overlay; north keeps the clean rear fallback.
Three palette swaps rotate by row. Literal 48 / 40 px cells are the gameplay-distance readability gate.
Authored source set: vest.panel.south · vest.neck-inset.south · vest.buttons.south
